who.title: Who We Are
who.body: Dynamite Faith Church International is a Christ-centred family of believers in Atebubu, Bono East Region. We gather to worship God, to study His Word together, and to care for one another and for our community. [Placeholder — replace with the church’s own description.]

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: A thriving community of believers, strong in prayer and in the Word, raising generations who love God and serve people. [Placeholder — replace with the church’s vision statement.]
